decision_table.recommended_next_action: Build 05ad few-shot calibration confirmatory/stability audit before any new physiology or architecture search.
decision_table.interpretation: Residual structure appears mainly subject-specific. Current zero-shot physiology features do not beat stimulus-only, and physiology does not add value after few-shot calibration. Future claims should compare against a locked few-shot baseline.

next_steps.title: Few-shot calibration confirmatory stability audit
next_steps.purpose: Validate 05aa with paired subject statistics, calibration-size curves, bootstrap/sign tests, and subject-level failure analysis.
next_steps.why_now: 05aa is the only route that clearly moves beyond stimulus-only; 05ab says physiology does not add after few-shot.
next_steps.success_condition: Arousal remains positive with subject-level win margin and CI/p-value support; valence is classified honestly as weak/unstable or recoverable.

next_steps.title: Subject calibration model-family comparison
next_steps.purpose: Compare mean-bias, shrinkage, ridge residual calibration, hierarchical/mixed-effect calibration, and small adapter models.
next_steps.why_now: 05z says residual is subject-profile structured, so the math should target subject calibration directly.
next_steps.success_condition: A method beats the simple few-shot bias baseline, not just stimulus-only.

next_steps.title: Physiology as moderator of personalization
next_steps.purpose: Use physiology only as a moderator/adapter after 05ad/05ae, not as standalone zero-shot decoder.
next_steps.why_now: 05ab says current physiology does not improve after few-shot, so future physiology claims need a stricter target.
next_steps.success_condition: Physiology improves over the locked few-shot baseline with paired subject-level evidence.
